headline: James Gunn and Peter Safran step down as DC Studios co-CEOs
summary: James Gunn and Peter Safran are leaving as co-CEOs of DC Studios, with former Marvel executive Jeremy Latcham taking over; Gunn and Safran will continue producing on DC projects.

claims.statement: Gunn and Safran are leaving DC Studios leadership and being replaced by Jeremy Latcham.

sources.quote: James Gunn is out as DC movie leader
DCU shake-up: James Gunn and Peter Safran out post-merger
Producer and former Kevin Feige protege Jeremy Latcham will replace Gunn and Safran.

claims.statement: Gunn and Safran will keep producing on various DC projects despite leaving leadership.

sources.quote: Gunn and Safran will "continue to produce on various DC projects"
